## Problem

What is hard or impossible today. Describe the situation, not the solution.

## Proposed change

What you would like the project to do instead.

## Which module would change

- [ ] `streaming-core`
- [ ] `streaming-s3-example`
- [ ] `streaming-s3-example-java`
- [ ] Build, deployment or scripts (not a module)

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve the same problem, and why they are worse.

## Scope check

This repository is a minimal, runnable example of API Gateway response streaming from a JVM Lambda. It deliberately carries no business logic.

- [ ] The change keeps the example minimal, or the extra complexity earns its place in the guide.
- [ ] The change does not add authentication, business logic or a second use case that the streaming mechanism does not need.

## Additional context

Links to AWS documentation, the relevant part of `docs/article.md`, or a prior issue.
